title: Single gate fan-out expansion step
statement: Given a number $n$, a state consisting of a gate list, a map from natural numbers to natural numbers, and a counter, and a gate $g$, write the state as $(G,t,N)$. The step appends to $G$ the gate with the same kind as $g$ and with each argument $a$ replaced by $t(a)$, followed by one AND gate with sole argument $t(a)$ for each argument $a$ of $g$. It replaces $t(v)$ by $n+|G|$ when $v=N$, by $n+|G|+1+i$ when $v$ occurs in the argument list of $g$ at index $i$, and otherwise leaves $t(v)$ unchanged; the new counter is $N+1$.
hypotheses_covered: input state (gate list, natural-number map, counter)
